description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing user account profile state, including fetching and updating user profile data, and handling related UI notifications.

methods.name: accountChange
methods.description: Creates an action to change a specific account field value.

methods.name: clearAccount
methods.description: Creates an action to clear account data.

methods.name: setProfileLoading
methods.description: Creates an action to set the profile loading state.

methods.name: fetchProfile
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to fetch user profile data from the API.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action to update user profile data via API.
